进水：模型按程序时间抬升水位，标示进水阀与水位传感器的位置；不模拟真实测量或阀门: Fill: water level rises with program time, with the inlet valve and level sensor marked. Real measurement and valve control are not simulated.
洗涤：加热器加热水，电机通过皮带带动滚筒交替转动。提升筋将衣物带起、落下，帮助洗: Wash: the heater warms the water and a belt-driven motor alternates drum direction. Lifters raise and drop laundry to help clean it.
排水：模型水位随程序阶段下降，标示排水泵与排水管的位置；不模拟泵内水流。: Drain: model water level falls with the program stage. Pump and hose positions are marked; internal pump flow is not simulated.
脱水：滚筒高速旋转，水从筒壁小孔排出。弹簧、减振器和配重共同减轻机身晃动。: Spin: the drum rotates fast and water leaves through its holes. Springs, dampers and weights reduce body movement together.

模型按程序时间抬升水位；进水阀与水位传感器是对应部件的示意，不是真实测量或阀门控: Water level rises with program time. The inlet valve and level sensor are corresponding part illustrations, not real measurement or valve-control simulation.
电机通过皮带带动滚筒换向，衣物被提升后落下；此时水位保持。: A belt-driven motor alternates drum rotation, lifting and dropping laundry. Water level stays constant during this stage.
模型水位随排水阶段下降，滚筒保持低速；内部标示排水泵位置，不模拟泵内水流。: Water level falls during draining while the drum stays slow. The pump position is marked; internal water flow is not simulated.
排水后滚筒加速旋转，水从筒壁小孔排出；程序结束前再缓缓停转。: After draining, the drum accelerates to spin water through its holes, then slows before the program ends.
滚筒已停、水已排空，门锁释放后才可开门取衣。: Drum stopped and water drained. Open and unload only after the lock releases.
舱门锁住后才会启动；门开着或加料抽屉未关时，不会开始。: Starting requires the door to latch and lock. An open door or detergent drawer prevents startup.
先装衣、加料并关好舱门，再启动程序。也可打开“查看内部”观察传动与管路。: Load laundry, add detergent and close the door before starting. Open the interior view to see the drive and pipes.
舱门扣合后门锁才会锁住，随后开始所选程序。: After the door latches, the lock engages and the selected program starts.
滚筒已停止，等待门锁释放后才能开门取衣。: Drum stopped. Wait for unlock before opening and unloading.
舱门已完全打开，衣物从滚筒移回衣篮；转移结束后即可开始下一轮。: Door fully open. Laundry moves from drum to basket; another cycle can start once transfer finishes.
舱门已完全打开，衣物正从衣篮移入滚筒；装好后舱门自动关闭。: Door fully open. Laundry moves from basket to drum, then the door closes automatically.
衣物已经装入，舱门正在自动扣合；关好后才能加料并启动。: Laundry loaded; the door is latching automatically. Close fully before adding detergent and starting.
先把舱门打开到位，再将衣物装入滚筒，不会穿过未打开的舱门。: Open the door fully before loading; laundry does not pass through a closed door.
洗涤剂倒入抽屉槽内；加料结束后抽屉自动关闭，等待进水时带入外桶。: Detergent pours into the drawer compartment. After loading, the drawer closes automatically; filling carries detergent into the outer tub.
拉开洗涤剂抽屉后才能向槽内加料。: Open the detergent drawer before adding to its compartment.
抽屉推回机身，关好后才能启动程序。: The drawer returns into the body. Close it fully before starting.
门锁已释放，舱门正在打开；开到位后衣物才会移回衣篮。: Lock released; door opening. Laundry moves back to the basket only after full opening.
舱门正在扣合；关闭到位后才允许启动。: Door latching. Startup is allowed only after full closure.
滚筒已停、水已排空、门锁已释放；现在可以开门取衣。: Drum stopped, water drained and lock released. Open the door to unload.
衣物已回到衣篮，滚筒为空；再次装衣即可开始新一轮。: Laundry back in basket; drum empty. Reload to start another cycle.
舱门打开时不能启动；完成装衣或取衣后，再关闭舱门。: Startup is blocked with an open door. Finish loading or unloading, then close it.

水位、滚筒和阶段来自同一演示时钟。展开分步卡片可边操作边观察；“查看内部”只显示: Water level, drum and stage share one demonstration clock. Open a step card to operate and observe. Interior view shows only parts already in the model.
